title: Reduction of the pulled-back condensed ell-adic integers
statement: Let $\ell$ be a prime, let $X$ be any scheme, and let $r\ge1$, with $\mathbf Z_\ell$ as in [def-weil-l-adic-numbers]. On the small pro-etale site of $X$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], put $R_X=p_X^*\underline{\mathbf Z}_\ell$ using the coefficient pullback [sk-def-sfb-pullback-from-point], where $\underline{\mathbf Z}_\ell(S)=C(S,\mathbf Z_\ell)$ is the continuous-function condensed ring [def-sfb-padic-int-condensed-ring], and put $A_{r,X}=(\mathbf Z/\ell^r\mathbf Z)_X$ for the constant sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Let $\rho_r\colon R_X\to A_{r,X}$ be the reduction map: the composite of the canonical ring isomorphism $R_X\cong\varprojlim_{n\geq1}A_{n,X}$ of [sk-prop-sfb-qlbar-colimit-x] in the case $E=\mathbf Q_\ell$ (the limit taken along the reduction maps $A_{n+1,X}\to A_{n,X}$) with the projection to the index $r$. Then $\rho_r$ induces an isomorphism of sheaves of rings and $R_X$-modules $$R_X/\ell^rR_X\xrightarrow{\sim}A_{r,X}.$$ Here $\ell^rR_X$ is the image ideal sheaf of multiplication by $\ell^r$, and the quotient is the sheaf quotient, with quotient-ring operations as in [def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient]. These isomorphisms are compatible with the reduction maps for all $r$: $\rho_r$ is $\rho_{r+1}$ followed by $A_{r+1,X}\to A_{r,X}$, so the quotient map $R_X/\ell^{r+1}R_X\to R_X/\ell^rR_X$ corresponds to the reduction $A_{r+1,X}\to A_{r,X}$.

source.place: Integral limit and coefficient extension; the quotient comparison needed to identify the exact upstream Tate construction
